units.source_text: “我的手虽尽给人按摩，可是耳朵还灵。

en.t: Though my hands are worn out from massaging people, my ears are still sharp.

units.source_text: 艺妓的三弦琴弹成这个样子，听起来叫人焦急。

en.t: When a geisha plays the shamisen like this, it is frustrating to listen to.

units.source_text: 是啊，或许就像自己当年所弹的那样。”

en.t: Yes, perhaps it sounds just like the way I used to play back then.
